③ Hold 5–10 sec × 5–10 reps, twice a day.
④ Over weeks, work back towards lunges.

caption:
Lulu felt a twinge in the inner thigh during side lunges, and now even walking pulls a little in the groin.

The adductors bring your legs together and help steady the pelvis. Stretching hard straight after a strain can irritate it, so gentle squeezes and a gradual return to load are usually more helpful.

Hybi's 1-minute return: ball squeeze between the knees, hold 5–10 seconds, 5–10 reps, twice a day. Work back towards lunges over a few weeks.

A pop with bruising, limping, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
